image_description: A monochrome close-up of a metallic flip-top lighter, resembling a Zippo style, with the lid open. A bright, stylized flame emerges from the top right. The body features a perforated wind guard design and embossed text reading 'SHERLOCK' on the front face. The background is a smooth, out-of-focus gray gradient.

artifact_observations.location: Front face of the lighter body
artifact_observations.reasoning: The embossed text reads 'SHERLOCK' but the letterforms are slightly malformed and unevenly spaced, characteristic of AI-generated text rendering issues. The kerning is inconsistent.

The perforated holes on the wind guard lack logical consistency; some holes merge into each other or fade into the metal without clear edges, indicating a failure in maintaining rigid geometric structure.

The flame appears as a solid, overexposed white shape rather than a translucent, dynamic fire element. It lacks the typical gradient and turbulence of a real flame, looking more like a glowing graphic overlay.
